method: Six parallel read-only research agents (web search and fetch) checked each of 124 owner-listed titles; the lead merged results, corrected several, ran an automated link check (HTTP status) and a manual recheck of failures.

access_legend.FREE: full text legally free (usually an older public-domain translation; US public domain unless noted)
access_legend.BORROW: Internet Archive lending or library e-book
access_legend.COMMERCIAL: purchasable edition or e-book; no free full text found
